**24 palavras novas** (linguagem especializada).
**Texto do dia:** poema, haiku ou letra.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo contrastar condicionais (zero, 1º, 2º, 3º, mistos e invertidos) e subjuntivo (insist that he be) num poema.

body: Esta aula treina **responder em frases completas (IELTS Speaking, TOEFL Speaking)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: If Only, Were It Not
lines: Were it not for the rain, I would walk home;
had I known, I’d have left before the storm.
I wish you were here; I wish you had stayed.
I insist that the window be left open,
as if the dark were a guest we could trust,
and supposing it speaks, what then shall we say?

items.q: The speaker will walk home despite the rain.
items.why: Were it not for the rain.

items.q: The speaker wishes the other person had stayed.
The speaker wants the window closed.
“I insist that the window be left open” usa ?

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
Sentido
rows: **as if the dark were** a guest

blocks.body: **Subjuntivo mandativo**: *insist/demand/suggest/recommend that + sujeito + base verb*. **Were** vale para todas as pessoas no hipotético formal.
*I insist that he is here* ✗ → **be here** ✓ (subjuntivo).

items.s: I wish you ___ here now. (be, hipotético)
I wish you ___ stayed last night. (have)
I insist that the window ___ left open. (be)
He acts as if he ___ the owner. (be, hipotético)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: And I wish you were here
Because it is the mandative subjunctive

body: **If only I had known.** — Se ao menos eu soubesse.
**Be careful what you wish for.** — Cuidado com o que deseja.
**It’s high time.** — Já é hora.
**Wishful thinking.** — Pensamento positivo irreal.
**Hindsight is 20/20.** — Em retrospecto tudo é claro.
**What if…?** — E se…?
**As luck would have it,…** — Por sorte,…
**Should the need arise,…** — Caso seja necessário,…
**Come what may.** — Aconteça o que acontecer.
**Would that it were so.** — Quem dera fosse assim.
**Because it is the mandative subjunctive.** — Porque é o subjuntivo mandativo.
**And “I wish you were here”?** — E “I wish you were here”?
**Why “be” in “I insist that the window be left open”?** — Por que “be” em “I insist that the window be left open”?

blocks.title: Poetry class
lines: Why “be” in “I insist that the window be left open”?
Por que “be” em “I insist that the window be left open”?
Because it is the mandative subjunctive.
A present wish, so were for every person.
Um desejo presente, então were para todas as pessoas.

items.label: Ajuste refinado de entonação
items.note: Ajuste refinado de entonação: pequenas variações de altura e de ritmo mudam a atitude (cortesia, ironia, reserva, compromisso) sem mudar as palavras.
words: I suppose that’s one way to put it. ↘↗ (reserva)
Well, that’s ONE way to put it. ↘ (ironia)

prompts.model: I wish I had called you.
The board insists that he resign.
She talks as if she knew everything.

blocks.task: Write a 6-line poem or paragraph with wish, as if and the mandative subjunctive.
blocks.model: I wish you were here to see the snow. I wish I had said it sooner. They insist that the road be closed, as if the mountain were a king. Were it not for the cold, I would stay. Supposing the night were kind, what would we say? I suggest that we simply listen.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
